{#- The two buttons in the hero and in the band above the footer: the most useful things to do right now, picked from the config's flags. Before and during the conference the asks are ranked tickets, talks, schedule, speakers, attendee guide, sponsoring, then the welcome post; after it (flagpostconf) they are the videos, the recap and the photos. A config with a `buttons` block keeps its own lists (2026 and earlier). -#} {%- macro conference_buttons(place) -%} {%- set conf = 'conf/' + shortcode + '/' + year_str -%} {%- if buttons is defined and buttons[place] -%} {%- set picks = buttons[place] -%} {%- else -%} {%- if flagpostconf -%} {%- set candidates = [ {'text': 'Watch the videos', 'link_absolute': videos.playlist if videos is defined else '', 'show': videos is defined and videos.playlist}, {'text': 'Conference recap', 'link': '/news/thanks-recap', 'show': true}, {'text': 'Browse the photos', 'link_absolute': photos.album if photos.album is defined else '', 'show': photos.album is defined and photos.album}, ] -%} {%- else -%} {%- set candidates = [ {'text': 'Buy a Ticket', 'link': '/tickets', 'show': flagticketsonsale and not flagsoldout}, {'text': 'Submit a Talk', 'link': '/cfp', 'show': flagcfp}, {'text': 'See the Schedule', 'link': '/schedule', 'show': flaghasschedule}, {'text': 'See the Speakers', 'link': '/speakers', 'show': flagspeakersannounced}, {'text': 'Attendee Guide', 'link': '/attendee-guide', 'show': flaghasattendeeguide}, {'text': 'Sponsor the Conference', 'link': '/sponsors/prospectus', 'show': flaghassponsors}, {'text': 'Date and ticket information', 'link': '/news/welcome', 'show': true}, ] -%} {%- endif -%} {%- set picks = (candidates|selectattr('show')|list)[:2] -%} {%- endif -%}
{%- for callout in picks %} {{ button_link(callout.link_absolute or pathto(conf + callout.link), callout.text, year, wrap=False, new_tab=False, contrast=True) }} {%- endfor %}
{%- endmacro -%}
